Hello everyone,
I am, Dr. Akshay Kumar PT and I welcome you to my YouTube channel, where I'll be sharing my expertise on various topics related to physiotherapy!

As a physiotherapist, I'm passionate about helping people recover from injuries, manage pain, and improve their overall physical function. On this channel, you'll find lectures covering a wide range of subjects, including exercise therapy, electrotherapy, PT Ortho, PT neuro, PT cardio, and PT gyne.

My goal is to provide you with accurate information that's easy to understand and apply. If you are a medical student & interested in learning more about these subjects, my hope is that you'll find my videos informative, engaging, and helpful.

So, if you're ready to deepen your knowledge of physiotherapy and improve your clinical skills, be sure to subscribe to my channel and hit the notification bell so you never miss an update. Thanks for tuning in!
